subject.title: feat(session): add chat-channel session switching with LRU history retention

question: Should maintainers repair this branch around `/sessions` plus `session.historyLimit`, choose the `/resume` direction from #82684, or design a new canonical chat-session command under #86829?
rationale: The remaining issue is not just mechanical: two open candidate PRs propose overlapping command surfaces and the final behavior affects session state, auth/provider routing, cleanup, and user-visible chat UX.

options.title: Repair this branch as the canonical `/sessions` path
options.body: Keep `/sessions` as the chosen command family, but require a rebase, real chat proof, cleanup references, disabled-history handling, and full session-boundary restore before merge.

options.title: Switch canonical work to `/resume`
options.body: Pause or close this PR after a better `/resume` implementation is made landable and proven under #86829.

options.title: Redesign the command shape first
options.body: Leave both implementation PRs blocked while maintainers define the stable chat-session list/resume contract and native-picker expectations.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch as the canonical `/sessions` path
recommendation.body: Keep `/sessions` as the chosen command family, but require a rebase, real chat proof, cleanup references, disabled-history handling, and full session-boundary restore before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses current session/config ownership, cleanup behavior, and maintainer-facing product policy; steipete has the strongest recent history on those central paths.
